verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's virtual mail page (Earth Class Mail is now part of LegalZoom) says mail is opened and scanned in facilities it operates with access controls, and that it uses 256-bit AES encryption and two-factor authentication. Earth Class Mail's own site adds only a general claim of secure cloud storage. These are brief marketing claims rather than detailed security documentation, and staff screening is never mentioned. Missing for 10: staff screening/background-check documentation, detail on facility controls (e.g. surveillance, chain of custody), explicit confirmation that the encryption covers stored scans at rest and in transit, any formal security or compliance documentation, and independent corroboration.
